# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

In her youth, Ruby was known for her showy looks, brilliant complexion, plump figure, and bright blue eyes, alongside long golden braids of hair. Before her passing, her illness left her very thin with transparent hands, an excessively bright blue gaze, and a hectically brilliant color in her cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005)_

## Personality

Ruby was cheerful, good-tempered, and inclined toward laughter, enjoying the pleasant things in life. She was frequently nervous or prone to hysterics during stressful scenes. From a young age, she was intensely preoccupied with boys, romance, and suitors, often boasting about her popularity and admiring romance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school alongside Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews. She passed the Entrance exams and studied for her teaching license at Queen's Academy. Upon completing her studies, she accepted a teaching position at Carmody, returning home on weekends. She attracted numerous suitors, including Nelson Atkins and Herb Spencer, as well as a former teacher in Spencervale. Later, Ruby fell ill with galloping consumption and was forced to stop teaching. During her final illness, she reconciled with her former childhood friend Em White and shared a quiet farewell evening with Anne before passing away peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v3 c8 P3](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0003), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_
